en.title: ai in mai (May / more)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong ai as found in the word mai.

sections.title: The letter group ai
paragraphs: The letters ai are spoken as the sound /aj/. They make the main sound in the word (mai) /maj/, which means more or May. This letter group has two spoken forms in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth wide. Glide your tongue up towards the roof of your mouth. Your lips stay relaxed. For the other sound, open your mouth wide first. Then lift your tongue high and smile to make a separate second vowel. Touch your throat to feel your voice buzz throughout.

sections.title: When to use each
paragraphs: The letters ai usually blend into one syllable as the sound /aj/, like in (haină) /ˈhaj.nə/. When separated across two syllables, they sound as two distinct vowels with the sound /a.i/, as heard in (aurit) /a.uˈrit/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make this sound like the vowel in the English word rain. The Romanian sound is much more open, exactly like the vowel sound in the English word my. Move smoothly from an open vowel to a quick glide without adding extra puff of air.
